study: F3 WP3.2 slice S3: the Earth's shadow on the spacecraft (EARTH_SHADOW) as an opt-in production force term (REQ-DYN-007, DYN-08)
written: 2026-11-25, before any S3 code, test or number. Read before writing: the WP3.1 study term (studies/phase17/scripts/wp3_1_force_terms.py: earth_illumination, earth_shadow_acceleration) and the WP3.1 survey report (EARTH_SHADOW 200 sigma on the eclipse arcs E2/E3, K_SRP aliasing, 'EARTH_SHADOW needs its own contacts in the event-segmented profile'), srp.py (illumination_fraction, _illumination_and_gradient, srp_acceleration_position_gradient, srp_acceleration_kernel), the dynamics.py SRP/tide/LRP wrappers, the D2 contact pre-pass (_shadow_contact_times) and contact check (_shadow_contact_check), propagate_state_with_k_sensitivity, propagation_contract.py, the S1 and S2 predeclarations, reports, tests and identity scripts, the lunar J2 model switch (lunar_j2_model.use_lunar_j2_model, lunar_j2_orientation) and spice_loader. No S3 code, test or gate value exists. One fact was checked: the SPICE kernel directory resolves on this machine, so real-ephemeris gates are feasible
base: branch f3/wp3-2-s3-earth-shadow from main 7864ae0 (merge of PR #118, WP3.2 S1 and S2)
scope_decision: WP3.1-R decision 2026-11-08 (survey report section 9): EARTH_SHADOW goes in as an opt-in term with defaults and frozen results unchanged, and it needs its own contacts in the event-segmented (D2) profile, otherwise its penumbra kinks bring the integration floor back on eclipse arcs. S3 is the third WP3.2 slice
question: Does the production propagator, with the opt-in Earth shadow, integrate the term WP3.1 found material (200 sigma on eclipse arcs), with a variational gradient and K_SRP sensitivity that match it, Earth-shadow contacts in the D2 segmentation, and an illumination accurate to the materiality requirement, without changing any existing path (default, tide-on or LRP-on)?

physics.model: the WP3.1 EARTH_SHADOW model, unchanged: the SRP acceleration is multiplied by the Earth's illumination factor nu_E, the visible fraction of the solar disk with the Earth as occulter under production's conical model (Sun and Earth as uniform disks on the sky with angular radii asin(R/d), nu_E = 1 - lens area / Sun disk area; srp.illumination_fraction with the occulter at the Moon-centred Earth position). The Earth is a sphere of radius R_E = 6378.137 km (WGS-84 equatorial, WP3.1's R_EARTH_SHADOW_M). Exact early exit as WP3.1 and the production lunar shadow: nu_E = 1 when (r_sc - r_E).(r_sun - r_E) > 0. The two occulters multiply: a = K P(d) nu_M nu_E u. Geometric positions (no light time), no atmosphere, no limb darkening, no flattening (WP3.1 survey section 9)
physics.form: production adds the increment da = (nu_E - 1) a_SRP to the existing SRP, where a_SRP = srp_acceleration_with_lunar_shadow (the production SRP with the lunar shadow of srp.shadow_model). This is WP3.1's earth_shadow_acceleration expression, so production equals the WP3.1 term bit for bit
physics.gradient: d(da)/dr = (nu_E - 1) G_SRP + a_SRP (grad nu_E)^T, with G_SRP = srp_acceleration_position_gradient and grad nu_E the exact derivative of the conical formula: srp._illumination_and_gradient's derivation (apparent radii, separation, lens partials dL/dr_i = 2 r_i theta_i, dL/dd = -2 h) generalised from an occulter at the origin to one at r_E. grad nu_E is continuous across both contacts; nu_E is not twice differentiable there
physics.k: the increment is K times (nu_E - 1) g_SRP, g_SRP = srp_acceleration_kernel, so the Earth shadow's part of df/dK is (nu_E - 1) g_SRP and K = 0 stays legal
physics.size: at the Moon the Earth's penumbra is ~3600 km wide (nu_E from 1 to 0, |grad nu_E| ~3e-7 /m) and the umbra radius ~4600 km. In a central eclipse SRP is off for ~2.7 h at the Moon centre with ~1 h of penumbra on either side; WP3.1: SRP off for 17-22 % of the eclipse day, 200 sigma
physics.requirement: WP3.1's EARTH_SHADOW response is 200 sigma, so a model error that is a fraction f of the term moves the solution by up to about 200 f sigma. Keeping that below 0.1 sigma with a factor 2 margin requires f <= 0.1 / 200 / 2 = 2.5e-4. The term's peak magnitude is |a_SRP| (nu_E = 0), so the requirement is |nu_E,prod - nu_E,true| <= 2.5e-4 absolute. This sets the E_G3(a) threshold

design.module: new src/lunar_od/earth_shadow.py: frozen keyword-only EarthShadowOptions(radius_m=6_378_137.0, provenance=<WP3.1 model and decision>); require_earth_shadow_options; earth_illumination(r_sc, r_sun, r_earth, options) -> nu_E (WP3.1's early exit and srp.illumination_fraction, unchanged); earth_illumination_and_gradient(...) -> (nu_E, grad nu_E) with the same value; earth_shadow_contact_functions(r_sc, r_sun, r_earth, options) -> (gamma - (a_s + a_E), gamma - |a_s - a_E|); earth_shadow_acceleration(r_sc, r_sun, r_earth, srp, options) -> the increment da. All positions Moon-centred inertial, SI units
design.validation: radius_m a finite real number > 0 (not bool); provenance a str; an earth_shadow that is neither None nor EarthShadowOptions raises TypeError; at propagation an earth_shadow without an active SRPOptions (srp None or disabled) raises ValueError, because the term scales the SRP acceleration and has nothing to scale otherwise; a spacecraft at or inside the Earth sphere raises ValueError
design.dynamics: dynamics._with_earth_shadow_acceleration(rhs, get_earth_pos, get_sun_pos, srp, earth_shadow, *, state_size) returns rhs ITSELF when earth_shadow is None. Otherwise: 6-state adds da to elements 3:6 and never evaluates a gradient; 42-state also adds G_ES @ Phi[0:3, :] to rows 3:6 of Phi_dot (G_ES = d(da)/dr); 48-state also adds G_ES @ s_K[0:3] + (nu_E - 1) g_SRP to s_K_dot[3:6]. Where nu_E = 1 (sunward half-space or full light) the wrapper adds nothing and evaluates nothing else. It is applied last, after the LRP wrapper, on every path (6-state, 42-state plain and harmonic, 48-state). With the Earth shadow on, the Earth position lookup is cached per epoch (_epoch_cached); with it off, the lookup objects are unchanged. Composition: the lunar shadow (srp.shadow_model) and the Earth shadow multiply; NO_SHADOW with the Earth shadow on gives the Earth shadow alone; the tide and the LRP are independent of it (the LRP is not dimmed by the Earth's shadow on the Moon, out of scope)
design.segmentation: with shadow_events=True and the Earth shadow on, the D2 pre-pass integrates the Earth-shadow-on RHS and adds the two Earth contact functions (outer gamma_E = a_s + a_E, inner gamma_E = |a_s - a_E|) to its events and to its grazing-pair extremum search, beside the lunar pair when srp.shadow_model is CONICAL_PENUMBRA, alone when it is NO_SHADOW. Segmentation is active when shadow_events and (lunar CONICAL_PENUMBRA SRP or the Earth shadow). The contact check accepts a cut that is a lunar or an Earth contact on the final trajectory, with the existing angle and time tolerances (_CONTACT_ANGLE_TOL_RAD, _CONTACT_TIME_TOL_S) unchanged. With the Earth shadow off the pre-pass event tuple, the check function and every branch are the existing ones
design.keywords: earth_shadow=None (keyword-only, appended last) wherever S2 added lunar_radiation: propagate_state, shadow_contact_times, propagate_augmented_state (plain and harmonic path), propagate_state_with_k_sensitivity, propagate_truth_with_ephemeris, _build_state_rhs, _propagate_augmented_with_harmonics
design.transport_S3b: propagation_contract.model_options and propagator_options(srp, propagation_profile, lunar_tide=None, lunar_radiation=None, earth_shadow=None): the key 'earth_shadow' appears only when an EarthShadowOptions is given. The 15 estimators.py functions that carry lunar_radiation gain earth_shadow=None and forward it to every propagation, and the two _prop dicts of the two-way solves carry it as they carry lunar_radiation
design.deferred: as S1/S2: UKF, EKF, fast sigma, scenarios, scenario_config, CLI, desktop, observability, numerical_metadata, force contract. None of them can enable the Earth shadow (fail closed by absence). numerical_metadata reports shadow_events from the lunar model only, so an Earth-shadow-only NO_SHADOW profile would be reported as unsegmented; it joins with the scenario-level transport after S4

lunar_j2: main's F1 X-02 default lunar J2 (grail_pa_de440) refuses J2_MOON_UNNORMALIZED and needs an arc epoch. The synthetic-geometry gates (E_G1(a), E_G2, E_G4, E_G5, E_G6(i)-(iv), E_G7, E_G8, EB_G1-EB_G3) run on the legacy mean-pole model via a module-scoped autouse use_lunar_j2_model('iau_mean_pole_legacy') fixture, as S1/S2, so they test the physics S1/S2 were evaluated on. The real-ephemeris cases run on the default model: E_G1(b)'s four E2 configurations and E_G6(v) pass J2_MOON_GRAIL_UNNORMALIZED with lunar_j2_model='grail_pa_de440' and the epoch of a MoonCenteredEphemeris; E_G3(b) has no J2

geometry.synthetic_eclipse: S1's synthetic Earth (circle of 384400 km, sidereal month, 23.44 deg tilt, phase 0) and a Sun on the coplanar circle sun_E(t) = circle(AU, sidereal year, phi_E, t) + earth(t) with phi_E = (W_EARTH - W_SUN) x 10800 s, so a central eclipse is greatest at t = 3 h. T6H = 0..6 h every 300 s. Orbits (100 km circular polar, as S1's _orbit with sun_E(0)): TERM = terminator orbit (no lunar shadow); PLANE = Sun in the orbit plane (lunar eclipses every revolution)
geometry.real_E2: WP3.1's E2: total lunar eclipse 2026-03-03, greatest eclipse t_ge by WP3.1's geometric rule (wp3_1_materiality_survey.greatest_eclipse_et); arc t_ge - 3 h .. t_ge + 3 h every 300 s; MoonCenteredEphemeris sampled by sample_moon_centered_ephemeris (60 s grid, 2 h margin); DE440 GMs; orbit PLANE at the arc start (Sun direction from the ephemeris, polar about the J2000 z axis as S1's _orbit). E3 (partial, 2026-08-28) is used by E_G3(b) only

gates.E_G1_DEFAULT_IDENTITY: (a) _with_earth_shadow_acceleration(rhs, ..., None, state_size=k) is rhs (object identity) for k in {6, 42, 48} and srp in {None, NO_SHADOW, disabled}. (b) New script studies/phase17/scripts/wp3_2_s3_default_identity.py runs the S1 T_G1(b) configuration set three times (as in S1; with lunar_tide = LunarTideOptions(TIDE_FREE) in every call; with lunar_radiation = LunarRadiationOptions() in every call), under use_lunar_j2_model('iau_mean_pole_legacy'), plus four real-E2 configurations on the default grail_pa_de440 J2 with CONICAL_PENUMBRA SRP K = 0.01 and D2 (propagate_state, propagate_augmented_state, propagate_state_with_k_sensitivity, shadow_contact_times): 79 configurations. Byte-identical SHA-256 of every output: before the change (this branch's base, run twice) and after it with earth_shadow omitted and with earth_shadow=None. A configuration whose outcome is an exception is recorded as the digest of its type and message and compares like any output; only two exceptions are expected and any other fails the gate: S1's fail-closed GM ValueError in the four tide-on range-rate solves (as S2) and S2's 'lunar_radiation needs an active SRPOptions' ValueError in the LRP-on configurations without active SRP
gates.E_G2_WP3_1_PARITY: 2000 samples, seed 20261125: Earth distance uniform in [356000, 407000] km, Sun distance uniform in [0.983, 1.017] AU, the Earth direction isotropic, the Sun direction at an angle delta uniform in [0, 1.5] deg from the anti-Earth direction about a random axis (so the Moon is near the Earth's shadow axis), spacecraft radius uniform in [R_MOON + 20 km, R_MOON + 3000 km] in an isotropic direction. Production earth_illumination equals wp3_1_force_terms.earth_illumination bit for bit, earth_illumination_and_gradient's value equals it bit for bit, and earth_shadow_acceleration equals wp3_1_force_terms.earth_shadow_acceleration bit for bit, for srp CONICAL_PENUMBRA and NO_SHADOW at K = 0.01. Precondition of the sample design: at least 300 penumbral (0 < nu_E < 1) and 300 umbral (nu_E = 0) samples
gates.E_G3_ACCURACY: (a) Independent spherical-geometry oracle: nu_ref = 1 - (solid angle of the solar cap hidden by the Earth sphere) / (solid angle of the solar cap), with the cap radii asin(R/d) and the separation from atan2(|cross|, dot), the hidden solid angle the 1-D scipy quad over the cap's polar angle rho of sin(rho) times the exactly hidden azimuth arc 2 acos(clip((cos a_E - cos rho cos gamma) / (sin rho sin gamma))), with breakpoints where the arc is empty or full, epsabs 1e-15. Precondition: with the Sun radius scaled by 1e-3 (small-angle limit) the oracle reproduces the planar lens formula to <= 1e-9 on 50 penumbral samples. On the E_G2 samples: max |nu_prod - nu_ref| <= 2.5e-4 (physics.requirement). (b) SPICE oracle on the real E2 and E3 eclipses: gfoclt with observer MOON, front EARTH, back SUN, both ELLIPSOID with the kernel-pool radii set to production's spheres (BODY399_RADII = 6378.137 km x 3, BODY10_RADII = R_SUN_M x 3, restored afterwards), abcorr NONE, types ANY and FULL, over t_ge +/- 6 h: the window boundaries equal the roots (brentq, xtol 1e-9 s) of production's earth_shadow_contact_functions at r_sc = 0 with spkpos positions, same count and max |dt| <= 0.01 s
gates.E_G4_GRADIENT: on the E_G2 samples whose Earth contact functions are both at least 1e-4 rad from zero and with 0 < nu_E < 1: (a) grad nu_E equals the 4-point central difference (h = 100 m) of wp3_1_force_terms.earth_illumination to <= 1e-6 relative (vector norm); (b) d(da)/dr equals the 4-point central difference (h = 100 m) of wp3_1_force_terms.earth_shadow_acceleration to <= 1e-6 relative (Frobenius), for srp NO_SHADOW, and for CONICAL_PENUMBRA on the subset whose lunar contact functions are at least 1e-2 rad from zero
gates.E_G5_VARIATIONAL: synthetic eclipse geometry, orbit TERM, Moon J2 (legacy), 6 h every 300 s, SRP NO_SHADOW with K = 0.2 m^2/kg (20x the physical prior, so the omitted-gradient control stands well above the oracle noise; reasoning before any number: the S2 control, 2.6e-6 at K = 0.05 with the LRP gradient on all 6 h, scales to ~1e-6 for the Earth-shadow gradient at K = 0.2 over ~2 h of penumbra), Earth shadow on, production propagators at DOP853 rtol 1e-13 atol 1e-14. Oracle: fixed-step RK4 (5 s) re-propagation of the PRODUCTION Earth-shadow-on 6-state RHS, central differences with h = 3 m and 3e-3 m/s (S2's steps). (a) max over columns of max|FD_j - Phi e_j| / max|Phi e_j| <= 1e-7; negative control, an analysis-only replica with the Earth shadow in the trajectory and no Earth-shadow gradient in the variational block: error >= 10x the gated error. (b) dK = 0.02: max|FD_K - s_K| / max|s_K| <= 1e-6; negative control, the 48-state run with the Earth-shadow part of df/dK removed (analysis-only replica): error >= 10x the gated error. (c) RHS structure at random states, no integration, including states in the lunar and Earth penumbrae: Earth-shadow-on minus off equals [0, da] in 0:6, G_ES @ Phi[0:3, :] in rows 3:6 of Phi_dot and G_ES @ s_K[0:3] + (nu_E - 1) g_SRP in s_K_dot[3:6], each to 4 eps of the base element magnitude, nothing else moves; the 6-state path never evaluates a gradient
gates.E_G6_PATH_CONSISTENCY: positions from the 6-, 42- (numba and, without harmonics, the reference) and 48-state propagations agree to 1e-5 m and Phi to 1e-8 of max|Phi|, and the Earth shadow moves the 6-state positions by more than 1 m, in five cases on the 6 h arcs at DOP853 rtol 1e-13 atol 1e-14: (i) TERM, J2, NO_SHADOW K = 0.05, no events; (ii) as (i) with the S1 tide; (iii) TERM, the S1 zonal synthetic harmonic model with harmonic_stm_opt_in, NO_SHADOW K = 0.05; (iv) PLANE, J2, CONICAL_PENUMBRA K = 0.05, shadow_events True (lunar and Earth contacts); (v) real E2, default grail_pa_de440 J2, CONICAL_PENUMBRA K = 0.05, shadow_events True
gates.E_G7_SHADOW_EVENTS: synthetic eclipse geometry, orbit PLANE, J2, SRP CONICAL_PENUMBRA K = 0.05, shadow_events True, DOP853 rtol 1e-11 atol 1e-12, T6H, Earth shadow on. (a) 6-, 42- and 48-state propagations complete and the contact check passes at every cut. (b) The Earth contacts reach the cut list: every cut of shadow_contact_times(earth_shadow=ES) is a lunar or an Earth contact of the 6-state D2 trajectory within _CONTACT_TIME_TOL_S (classified by its smallest contact-function time offset), at least 4 are Earth contacts, and the Earth-shadow-free cut list has no Earth contact. (c) The Earth shadow moves at least one lunar cut by more than _CONTACT_TIME_TOL_S, and segmenting the Earth-shadow-on RHS at the Earth-shadow-free cuts raises the contact-consistency RuntimeError. (d) Earth-shadow-only segmentation: with NO_SHADOW SRP and the Earth shadow on, orbit TERM, shadow_contact_times returns only Earth contacts (at least 2) and the D2 propagations complete. Information, not gated: the D2 position error at rtol 1e-11 against a rtol 1e-13 run with the same cuts, with and without the Earth contacts in the cut list
gates.E_G8_FAIL_CLOSED: each design.validation case raises: EarthShadowOptions with radius 0, negative, nan, inf, True, a string; positional construction (TypeError); a non-options earth_shadow (TypeError) and an earth_shadow with srp None and with SRPOptions(enabled=False) (ValueError) at every propagation entry point that takes the keyword and in model_options/propagator_options (TypeError); a spacecraft inside the Earth sphere (ValueError)
gates.E_G9_REGRESSION: full pytest: 0 failures, 0 errors, skips unchanged apart from the new tests' own; the S2 L_G6 strict xfails stay xfail; tools/check_repository.py passes; the protected-file re-freeze is additive (a new F3_WP3_2_S3 table first in expected_current_tree_sha256, history unchanged, docs/development/path-migration.json history extended, the history-chain tests extended)
gates.EB_G1_OPTIONS: for every combination of srp in {None, enabled, disabled}, profile in {None, PropagationProfile(), PropagationProfile('ADAMS', False)}, lunar_tide in {None, TIDE} and lunar_radiation in {None, LRP}: without earth_shadow the dicts equal the S2 dicts; with it they additionally hold exactly that object under 'earth_shadow'. A non-options value raises TypeError
gates.EB_G2_TRANSPORT: as S2 LB_G2: spies on every propagation entry point estimators.py calls, for the six public estimators (position and range-rate BLS-LM and SRIF, two-way range BLS-LM and SRIF with and without K solve-for): every captured call carries the given EarthShadowOptions object, and with earth_shadow omitted no call has the key
gates.EB_G3_RECOVERY: synthetic eclipse geometry, orbit TERM, noiseless position observations every 300 s over T6H from S1's three synthetic stations, truth from propagate_state with SRP NO_SHADOW K = 0.05, the Earth shadow on and PropagationProfile() settings (DOP853, shadow_events, rtol 1e-12 atol 1e-13). estimate_position_bls_lm and estimate_position_srif with the same SRP, the Earth shadow and PropagationProfile(), started 100 m and 0.1 m/s off: |dr0| < 1e-3 m and |dv0| < 1e-6 m/s; the same solve without the Earth shadow has |dr0| >= 100 x the Earth-shadow-on value

expectations: stated before the run, not gates: E_G2 exact (bit for bit, the same expressions); E_G3(a) ~1e-5..5e-5 (planar disks against spherical caps, a relative curvature correction of order a^2 with a <= 0.0166 rad), worst in the penumbra; E_G3(b) <= 1e-3 s; E_G4 ~1e-9..1e-8; E_G5(a) gated ~2e-8..5e-8 (the S1/S2 oracle floor), control ~5e-7..2e-6 (ratio 10..50, a real chance of falling below 10); E_G5(b) ~1e-8, control O(1e-1) (SRP off for ~2.7 h changes s_K at first order); E_G6 ~1e-7..2e-6 m in (i)-(iii) (C1 kinks of the Earth penumbra are gentle: nu_E changes over ~1 h), ~1e-6 m in (iv)-(v); Earth shadow effect ~10-40 m in 6 h at K = 0.05; E_G7 4-8 Earth contacts (the 100 km orbit carries the spacecraft back and forth across each boundary), lunar cut shifts ~5-10 ms; EB_G3 dr0 ~1e-5 m, without the Earth shadow ~0.1-10 m
out_of_scope: the atmospheric enlargement of the Earth's umbra (~2 %) and refraction, the Earth's flattening, limb darkening, the light-time displacement of the Earth's shadow (~38 km at the Moon; WP3.1 left it out, S4 handles SRP light time), the exact overlap of the two occulter disks when the Moon and the Earth both cover part of the Sun (the WP3.1 model multiplies them), the Earth's shadow on the lunar surface in the LRP and the LRP's thermal lag (S2 out of scope), the Earth shadow in UKF/EKF/fast sigma/scenario/config/CLI/desktop/observability/numerical metadata/force contract (design.deferred), and the OD materiality replication on the WP3.1 population (S5)
reject_if: if any gate fails, S3 is reported as computed and not offered for merge until a fix passes a gate set recorded in docs/assurance/amendment-log.md; a change to a gate after its result is exploratory (amendment log)
agent_decisions: agent decisions under the owner's 2026-11-08 delegation, flagged for review: (1) the WP3.1 model unchanged (conical, spherical Earth of 6378.137 km, occulters multiplied), so production equals the term WP3.1 measured, with its accuracy gated against the materiality requirement by an independent spherical-cap oracle and SPICE gfoclt; (2) a separate EarthShadowOptions and keyword instead of an SRPOptions field (asdict(SRPOptions) is recorded in numerical metadata and archives), requiring active SRP; (3) the Earth contacts added to the D2 pre-pass and contact check, active also with NO_SHADOW SRP, the existing tolerances unchanged; (4) the synthetic central eclipse at t = 3 h and the real E2/E3 eclipses as the gate geometry; (5) K = 0.2 in E_G5 only, chosen before any S3 number; (6) the legacy J2 fixture for the synthetic gates and the default GRAIL/DE440 J2 on the real-E2 cases; (7) the additive re-freeze of dynamics.py and estimators.py; (8) one branch and PR for the slice
